slides.kicker: ClaimsWatch  ·  Acentra Health “Build to Care” code-a-thon  ·  28 Sep 2026
slides.headline: When a Medicaid eligibility service fails, a patient can be turned away at the pharmacy.
lines: Acentra Health formed in `2023` from the merger of CNSI and Kepro, with about `3,300` employees and an office in Chennai.
An AWS Advanced Partner, it runs evoBrix X, a cloud-based Medicaid claims platform.
ClaimsWatch watches claims-service logs and tells on-call what broke, and where, within seconds.

slides.headline: Error-rate alerts tell the on-call engineer that something broke, but not what broke or where.
slides.left_note:
Which service? Which error? Which client?
The engineer starts digging through logs.
slides.right_label: The ClaimsWatch alert for the same incident
slides.caption: Both built from the same replayed database outage (`make replay`, seed `{outage[seed]}`).

slides.headline: Our detector learns normal behaviour from the log itself and flags errors that rise well above it.

image._crop_note: left, top, right, bottom fractions: the chart panel of the 1440x900 dashboard screenshot

lines: Median and MAD of the last `30` window error rates, so one past spike barely moves them.
`3.5` is the published outlier cut-off; `5` and `8` are our escalation steps.

slides.headline: From one log line to one alert, in six stages.

stages.title: Tail
stages.detail: Polls app.log every 250 ms; survives truncation and rotation.

stages.title: Parse + mask
stages.detail: PHI is masked before any field is extracted.

stages.title: Window
stages.detail: 10 s buckets roll into a 60 s error rate.

stages.title: Baseline
stages.detail: Median and MAD of the last 30 normal rates.

stages.title: Detect
stages.detail: Score and severity; incident opens, updates, resolves.

slides.headline: Patient data is masked before any alert leaves the server.
slides.left_label: One line from tools/loggen.py, before and after the parser
slides.right_label: The alert read back from SNS by tools/sns_tail.py
lines: Member IDs, names, dates of birth, e-mails, SSNs and phone numbers are tagged in the parser; nothing downstream sees them.
Right: the production AlertPublisher sent the replayed outage alert to moto_server; tools/sns_tail.py read it back via SNS → SQS.

slides.headline: Across `{replay[incidents]}` replayed incidents: all detected in `{replay[latency_min]}`–`{replay[latency_max]}` seconds, with `{replay[false_alarms]}` false alarms.
